run_benchmark_rbm_inference: run RBM inference benchmark comparing PGMax, pomegranate, and pgmpy on random RBM models
test_enumeration_infer: test brute-force enumeration inference on RBM with given weights and biases
test_pomegranate_infer: test pomegranate-based RBM inference with configurable backend and batch size
test_pgmax_infer: test PGMax-based RBM inference with JAX acceleration and configurable iterations
test_pgmpy_infer: test pgmpy-based RBM inference using MPLP MAP estimation on Markov networks
